title: Counit on the derived pullback of a reduced coefficient system
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y with l invertible in each residue field, f:X to Y, coefficient derived system calculi C on X and D on Y [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and an additive exact functor G equal to integralComparisonSequencePullback(f) [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. For any unbounded derived completed-coefficient object M on Y, the actual C counit at G.mapDerivedCategory(D.reduction(M)) is invertible. The equality identifying G is an implementation interface, not an effectivity assumption.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941, tensor compatibility and normalized reconstruction counit

theorem completedPullbackTensor_pullback_counit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.residueField x))
    (_hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.residueField y))
    (C : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (D : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y)
    (G : coefficientSequenceModules l E Y ⥤ coefficientSequenceModules l E X)
    [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (hG : G = integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y)) :
    IsIso (C.adjunction.counit.app
      ((G.mapDerivedCategory).obj
        (D.reduction.obj M)))
